content.text: The clause meets the preferred position in full.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 obliges Copperleaf (Vendor) to carry exactly the preferred coverages: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O USD 2M, and cyber/privacy USD 5M, maintained through the term plus one year, with certificates of insurance available on request (18.2). Section 18.2 also adds favourable extras for us — reputable insurers, primary coverage, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities. This is at or above the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
